add.k: Ava's father, a S.H.I.E.L.D. quantum scientist
st: Elihas Starr works on quantum research with Hank Pym at S.H.I.E.L.D. until Hank has him fired and discredited.
Rebuilding a quantum tunnel on his own, Starr tells his family to run as it overloads, and the blast kills him and his wife.

files.notes: Seen only in Ava's account of her past. Named aloud by Ava and by Hank ('Elihas Starr was a traitor. He stole my plans'). After the firing no group is named, so Independent. His wife is never named on screen.

add.k: A Quantum Realm rebel with a glowing head
st: Xolum blasts a monster attacking Scott and Cassie, brings them to Jentorra and keeps urging the rebels to torture them.
Captured when Kang's forces raid the camp, Xolum breaks free and fights in the revolt until Kang blasts his head apart.

files.notes: Named aloud by Jentorra during the raid ('And, Xolum.' 'Right here.'). The torture lines are his per the wiki. Group uses the app's existing name for Jentorra's rebels; the film calls them freedom fighters only loosely.

add.k: A CIA officer called back from retirement
st: Out of retirement, Smitty runs the vibranium dive at sea, pulls a sailor back from the edge and dies on Attuma's spear.

files.notes: Name said repeatedly ('Hey, Smitty, earplugs'). CIA rests on Ross calling the dive a joint operation of the Agency and the SEALs that lost 'two of our best officers'; the screen never shows Smitty's badge. The colonel rank and surname Smith are from the screenplay only, so left out.

add.k: A diver on the American vibranium dive
st: Diving to the vibranium detector on the seabed, Salazar reports that her partner Jackson is gone, then screams as her signal dies.

files.notes: Only her surname is said ('Salazar, do you copy?'); 'Rita' is from the credits, so n is Salazar. Group: Ross says the dive was a joint operation with the SEALs and Namor calls it the American military; she is not individually called a SEAL, so the app's U.S. Military is used. Her death is implied by Ross's count of the dead rather than shown.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Ava tells how her father Elihas Starr kept up his quantum work after Hank Pym had him fired. When his tunnel overloads he tells her to run, but she stays, and the blast kills her parents and leaves her phasing in pain.
stages.whoB: Her father, a fired S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Elihas Starr and Hank Pym are colleagues in quantum research at S.H.I.E.L.D. until Hank has him fired and discredited. Ava blames Hank for her father's fate, while Hank calls Starr a traitor who stole his plans.
stages.whoA: The colleague who had him fired

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Xolum brings Scott and Cassie to Jentorra and presses her to torture them. When Kang's forces strike, she orders him to get her people away. Later he hands her back her staff and fights beside her in the revolt.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Xolum and Quaz hold Scott and Cassie in the rebel camp. Quaz reads their minds and tells Xolum to stop suggesting they torture people.
stages.whoB: A rebel who keeps urging torture

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Xolum and Veb are among the rebels who greet Scott and Cassie after they drink the ooze. Both are taken prisoner in the raid on the camp and join the revolt against Kang.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Xolum saves Scott and Cassie from a monster, then wants Scott tortured as a spy. In the end he fights on the same side against Kang.
stages.whoA: A stranger he rescues and wants to torture
stages.whoB: A rebel who rescues him, then wants him tortured

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Xolum rescues Cassie and her father and urges the rebels to torture them. After Kang captures the rebels, Cassie frees them and calls the Quantum Realm to revolt, and Xolum fights in the uprising she starts.
stages.whoA: The girl who sparks the revolt
stages.whoB: A rebel who fights in her revolt

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Kang's forces raid the rebel camp and take Xolum prisoner. When the rebels rise up, Kang suits up and kills Xolum with a single blast to the head.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Smitty oversees the dive that sends Salazar and Jackson to the vibranium detector on the seabed. Salazar reports that Jackson is gone and her signal dies as the ship comes under attack.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: As a strange song lures the crew overboard, Smitty fights back with earplugs and a gun. Attuma drags a sailor into the sea and throws a spear that kills Smitty.
stages.whoA: The undersea warrior who kills him

dropped.why: The Watchdog is never named in the story; 'Alpha Dog' is a credits label (the wiki lists him under unnamed characters) and no dialogue or on-screen text gives a name. Re-checked: springfieldspringfield.co.uk has no Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot transcripts, and the wiki puts him in Unnamed Characters with 'Alpha Dog' only as a codename; no dialogue or on-screen text found that names him.

The FBI agent is never called Stoltz in the dialogue (only 'agent' and 'sir'; Burch phones an unnamed contact) and nothing shown names him; the name comes from the credits. Re-checked the Ant-Man and the Wasp transcript (springfieldspringfield ant-man-and-the-wasp): 'Stoltz' is never said; only 'Agent Woo' is named among the agents.

Owner's example: the launch tech is named only in the credits. A later 'Klein' mention in Avengers: Infinity War is never tied to him on screen. Re-checked the Avengers: Age of Ultron and Captain America: The Winter Soldier transcripts: 'Klein' is never said.
Her name is never said or shown in Natasha's Red Room vision in Avengers: Age of Ultron; 'Madame B.' is a credits name. Re-checked the Avengers: Age of Ultron transcript: 'Madame' is never said.
Klaue's accomplice is never named in the Black Panther dialogue or on screen; the name comes from the credits. Re-checked the Black Panther transcript: 'Limbani' is never said.

Only called the shaman (subtitled SHAMAN) in Black Panther and unnamed in Wakanda Forever; 'Sope' is never said or shown. Re-checked the Black Panther and Wakanda Forever transcripts: 'Sope' is never said; she is only 'the shaman'.

The Mining Tribe elder is never named in the dialogue of Black Panther or Wakanda Forever (addressed only as one of the elders); the name comes from credits and tie-in material. Re-checked the Black Panther and Wakanda Forever transcripts: 'Zawavari' is never said.

The CIA scientist is never called Graham in the dialogue (only Smitty and Salazar are named in the opening attack) and nothing shown names her; the name comes from the credits. Re-checked the Wakanda Forever transcript: 'Graham' is never said; the subtitles label her lines only 'DR.'.

changes.was: Xolum and Veb are among the rebels who greet Scott and Cassie after they drink the ooze. Both flee the raid on the camp and join the revolt against Kang.
changes.now: Xolum and Veb are among the rebels who greet Scott and Cassie after they drink the ooze. Both are taken prisoner in the raid on the camp and join the revolt against Kang.
changes.why: Veb and Xolum do not get away in the raid: Veb and Quaz are stopped by Quantumnauts and put in Kang's prison with the other rebels, and Xolum is overpowered and captured too (as Xolum's own step already says), before Jentorra and Cassie free them for the revolt.
